name: Nádasd (Hungary)
description: A vertical green banner charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Nádasd: a crowned green shield with a yellow bird and reeds, above a scroll inscribed NÁDASD.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Nádasd arms with crown and scroll
